message: not applied: `{card}`; every analysis runs at 27 °C (300.15 K)
description: Raised until 2.52.0, when `.temp` was not read and `$temperature`/`$vt` stayed at the nominal 300.15 K. Since 2.52.0 the card is applied (and `E0535` reports one that cannot be), so this code is no longer raised; it stays in the catalogue because a code is never reused.
actions: To simulate another temperature, set the device model's own temperature parameter on the instance (for example `dtemp=73` for 100 °C), if the model has one.
Check that the model you use reads `$temperature` at all: one that does not cannot be moved by any card.
